name: Dart Sass 1.105.1
body:
To install Sass 1.105.1, download one of the packages below and [add it to your PATH][], or see [the Sass website][] for full installation instructions.

[add it to your PATH]: https://katiek2.github.io/path-doc/
[the Sass website]: https://sass-lang.com/install

# Changes

* Improve error messages for `@extend`s across different media queries.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/sass/dart-sass/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#11051) for changes in earlier releases.
